45: class AIOHTTPTransport(AsyncTransport):
46:     """:ref:`Async Transport <async_transports>` to execute GraphQL queries
47:     on remote servers with an HTTP connection.
48: 
49:     This transport use the aiohttp library with asyncio.
50:     """
51: 
52:     file_classes: Tuple[Type[Any], ...] = (
53:         io.IOBase,
54:         aiohttp.StreamReader,
55:         AsyncGenerator,
56:     )

58:     def __init__(
59:         self,
60:         url: str,
61:         headers: Optional[LooseHeaders] = None,
62:         cookies: Optional[LooseCookies] = None,
63:         auth: Optional[Union[BasicAuth, "AppSyncAuthentication"]] = None,
64:         ssl: Union[SSLContext, bool, Fingerprint] = True,
65:         timeout: Optional[int] = None,
66:         ssl_close_timeout: Optional[Union[int, float]] = 10,
67:         json_serialize: Callable = json.dumps,
68:         json_deserialize: Callable = json.loads,
69:         client_session_args: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
70:     ) -> None:
71:         """Initialize the transport with the given aiohttp parameters.
72: 
73:         :param url: The GraphQL server URL. Example: 'https://server.com:PORT/path'.
74:         :param headers: Dict of HTTP Headers.
75:         :param cookies: Dict of HTTP cookies.
76:         :param auth: BasicAuth object to enable Basic HTTP auth if needed
77:                      Or Appsync Authentication class
78:         :param ssl: ssl_context of the connection.
79:                     Use ssl=False to not verify ssl certificates.
80:         :param ssl_close_timeout: Timeout in seconds to wait for the ssl connection
81:                                   to close properly
82:         :param json_serialize: Json serializer callable.
83:                 By default json.dumps() function
84:         :param json_deserialize: Json deserializer callable.
85:                 By default json.loads() function
86:         :param client_session_args: Dict of extra args passed to
87:                 `aiohttp.ClientSession`_
88: 
89:         .. _aiohttp.ClientSession:
90:           https://docs.aiohttp.org/en/stable/client_reference.html#aiohttp.ClientSession
91:         """
92:         self.url: str = url
93:         self.headers: Optional[LooseHeaders] = headers
94:         self.cookies: Optional[LooseCookies] = cookies
95:         self.auth: Optional[Union[BasicAuth, "AppSyncAuthentication"]] = auth
96:         self.ssl: Union[SSLContext, bool, Fingerprint] = ssl
97:         self.timeout: Optional[int] = timeout
98:         self.ssl_close_timeout: Optional[Union[int, float]] = ssl_close_timeout
99:         self.client_session_args = client_session_args
100:         self.session: Optional[aiohttp.ClientSession] = None
101:         self.response_headers: Optional[CIMultiDictProxy[str]]
102:         self.json_serialize: Callable = json_serialize
103:         self.json_deserialize: Callable = json_deserialize
104: 
105:     async def connect(self) -> None:
106:         """Coroutine which will create an aiohttp ClientSession() as self.session.
107: 
108:         Don't call this coroutine directly on the transport, instead use
109:         :code:`async with` on the client and this coroutine will be executed
110:         to create the session.
111: 
112:         Should be cleaned with a call to the close coroutine.
113:         """
114: 
115:         if self.session is None:
116: 
117:             client_session_args: Dict[str, Any] = {
118:                 "cookies": self.cookies,
119:                 "headers": self.headers,
120:                 "auth": (
121:                     None if isinstance(self.auth, AppSyncAuthentication) else self.auth
122:                 ),
123:                 "json_serialize": self.json_serialize,
124:             }
125: 
126:             if self.timeout is not None:
127:                 client_session_args["timeout"] = aiohttp.ClientTimeout(
128:                     total=self.timeout
129:                 )
130: 
131:             # Adding custom parameters passed from init
132:             if self.client_session_args:
133:                 client_session_args.update(self.client_session_args)
134: 
135:             log.debug("Connecting transport")
136: 
137:             self.session = aiohttp.ClientSession(**client_session_args)
138: 
139:         else:
140:             raise TransportAlreadyConnected("Transport is already connected")
141:

144:
